description: This is a Java test source file for testing order entry operations in the OpenMRS medical record system. It contains unit and integration tests for creating, revising, discontinuing, voiding, and querying Orders within the system.

classes.name: OrderEntryIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains end-to-end integration tests for order entry workflows such as placing, discontinuing, revising, voiding, and querying orders.

methods.name: shouldGetTheActiveOrdersForAPatient
methods.description: Tests retrieval of active orders for a patient.

methods.name: shouldGetTheActiveDrugOrdersForAPatient
methods.description: Tests retrieval of active drug orders for a patient.

methods.name: shouldPlaceADrugOrder
methods.description: Tests placing a new drug order in the system.

methods.name: shouldPlaceATestOrder
methods.description: Tests placing a new test order.

methods.name: shouldDiscontinueAnActiveOrder
methods.description: Tests discontinuing active orders with various reasons.

methods.name: shouldVoidAnOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests voiding an order and persisting the change.

methods.name: shouldDiscontinueAnActiveOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests discontinuing an order with flush.

methods.name: shouldReviseAnOrderAndFlushSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests revising an order with flush.

methods.name: shouldFailIfAnEditedOrderIsFlushed
methods.description: Tests that editing specific fields causes an exception when flushing.

methods.name: shouldNotReturnAProxyForPreviousOrder
methods.description: Verifies that the previous order returned is not a proxy object.

methods.name: shouldAllowEditingADiscontinuationOrder
methods.description: Tests editing and saving a discontinuation order.

methods.name: shouldAllowRetrospectiveDataEntryOfOrders
methods.description: Tests creating orders with past dates (retrospective data entry).

methods.name: shouldAllowRevisionOfOrdersInRetrospectiveDataEntry
methods.description: Tests revising orders created with retrospective dates.
